Name: Mancer's Music Pack
Author: TheMancer
Description:
Hey Nexus! :3

You probably know Hisame & Trent's awesome location mods. They are great, with awesome gameplay additions and visual design. And what goes well with awesome visuals?

Why, some nice music, of course!

This is my music pack, composed from scratch specifically for their location mods.

[size=1]Also, it's a secret don't tell anyone but I'm also making soundtracks for their upcoming mod, Ghibli Town

[/size][b]HOW DO I INSTALL THIS[/b]
Glad you asked! First, you need [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]﻿
Then, you probably need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4216]Mermaid Island[/url]﻿ and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120]Trent's Boarding House mod[/url]﻿ to hear the new music in game.
And finally, extract the content pack into your mod folder as usual and it should work just fine!

[b]HOW DO I UNINSTALL THIS[/b]
Just delete the folder with my content pack.
